description: This file implements logging utilities for HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer) modules, including functions to output log messages at various levels, initialize, and terminate logging. It also manages verbose logging via environment variables and external files.

methods.name: void HALUTIL_Logger_Message(eMessageLevel level,const char * function,int line,const char * format,...)
methods.description: Formats and outputs a log message at a specified log level, including function name and line number, with support for verbose logging and different output streams.

methods.name: void HALUTIL_LogModuleInit()
methods.description: Initializes logging settings based on environment and external indicators, called automatically at module load time.

methods.name: void HALUTIL_LogModuleTerminate()
methods.description: Logs the termination of logging, called automatically at module unload time.

ctags.signature: (eMessageLevel level,const char * function,int line,const char * format,...)
